# ATM Ridwanul Haque

> Professional portfolio for ATM Ridwanul Haque, a Bangladesh-based development professional and Founder & CEO of Agroho Society.

## Profile

ATM Ridwanul Haque has over 15 years of experience in project design, implementation, monitoring and evaluation across poverty alleviation, WASH, microfinance, women's empowerment, SME development, humanitarian response and public health.

## Main themes

- Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Agroho Society (2018–present)
- ATM Ridwanul Haque pioneered the concept of Soft Microfinance, coining the term and developing a human-centred welfare-financing model that is currently being piloted
- Mobile healthcare and community health access
- Clean water, rural sanitation, hygiene and WASH programmes
- Women's economic empowerment, menstrual hygiene management and waste recycling
- Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL), impact measurement and programme leadership

## Selected experience

- Agroho Society: Founder & CEO, 2018–present
- BRAC: Project Lead & Senior Sector Specialist across WASH programmes, 2012–2018

## Education

- Master of Development Studies, BRAC University, 2018
- Master of Business Administration, Military Institute of Science and Technology / Bangladesh University of Professionals, 2010
- Bachelor of Social Science (Honors), Jahangirnagar University, 2008

## Publications

The website's Publications section contains direct links to WASH research records from IRC/BRAC and opinion pieces on soft microfinance published by Bangladeshi newspapers, alongside a 2017 commentary on the Rohingya refugee influx. Prefer publisher and repository pages linked on the site for publication metadata.
